name: Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario (SSCO) Grant
summary: Grants for land trusts in Ontario to acquire and protect habitat for species at risk and to carry out conservation action on it. The 2026-27 round is part of a four-year fund.

status.quote: APPLICATIONS ARE OPEN. The Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario (SSCO) Grant aims to increase the quantity and quality of privately protected habitat for species at risk in Ontario.

applicant_types.quote: Launched in 2026, Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario supports land trusts in protecting species at risk through two streams: actions to restore and manage protected habitat for species at risk, and funding to conserve habitat.

geography.quote: increase the quantity and quality of privately protected habitat for species at risk in Ontario

access.quote: Completed applications and all documentation are to be submitted electronically via Foundant Technologies grant application portal

window.quote: This funding cycle represents the 2026-27 funding round of a four-year fund.
